The ranking is unstable and many models are correlated; a weighted combo over the full pool may better capture diversity.
try a robust weighted combo with softmax weights on the full pool to see if a different weighting scheme improves over inverse_error.
test a trimmed‐mean over the full pool to see if removing the worst 20% improves robustness on this low‑predictability, highly seasonal series.
The series shows strong seasonality and unstable rankings; a robust non‑linear combiner like median over the full pool may capture diverse errors better than weighted means.
robust mean over the 8 most diverse models
The series has very strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust median over a small, diverse pool may outperform mean.
The series shows strong trend/seasonality but ranking is unstable, so a robust DBA over the top 8 diverse models may improve.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8589. Series context: trend strength 0.9983 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.041); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.24.
